During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[R2z Starship Maintenance Droid|droid]] [[R2z-DL]], who was posing as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]], operated out of a '''repair shop''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hypotria]]. He had starships with potentially valuable information aboard routed to the facility so that he could, under the cover of working on the vessels, steal data off them and then pass it along to the Alliance.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
